prompt:
Create a draft visual asset for Vintage Telnet using the supplied art direction.

Asset type: creature

Target: Borrador de fauna natural de la Sierra de Hoshai para revisión anatómica y ambiental; no integrar a runtime.

Canonical name: Pliegaviento

Art direction: Escena de fauna con lectura anatómica prioritaria. Mostrar un adulto completo sobre cornisa de roca expuesta al viento, cuerpo compacto y bajo, seis apoyos legibles (cuatro patas principales y un par anterior reducido), membranas laterales tensas usadas como estabilizadores y nunca como alas. Cámara lateral tres cuartos a baja altura, luz diurna fría/neutra, paisaje subordinado. La silueta debe comunicar agarre, estabilidad y resistencia al viento, no vuelo.

Aspect ratio: landscape

Prompt: Create one landscape wildlife scene in the Sierra de Hoshai. Show one complete adult Pliegaviento, 55–75 cm long, on an exposed rocky ledge in strong mountain wind. Its body is compact, low and stable. It has exactly six supports: four main legs plus one reduced anterior pair associated with taut lateral stabilizing membranes. The membranes brace against gusts; they are not wings and the animal never flies or glides. Give it a wedge-shaped head, short neck, small protected lateral eyes, feet with two broad opposing toes gripping the rock, a short vertically flattened tail used for body steering, and matte leathery micro-scaled skin. Low three-quarter side view, anatomy unobscured, neutral/cool daylight. Background subordinate: Hoshai rock, elevation, sparse mountain vegetation and open wind exposure. Natural animal, no magic.

Canon sources supplied by the Art Director: vintage-telnet/ART_WORLD_GUIDE.md; vintage-telnet/CREATURES.md; vintage-telnet/REGIONS.md; vintage-telnet/SUPPLEMENTAL_REGIONAL_FAUNA.md

Do not include: No wings, feathers, flight or gliding; Do not resemble a dragon, bird, bat or generic fantasy lizard; Do not reduce the anatomy to four limbs; preserve exactly the canonical 4+2 six-support plan; No horns, magical glow, runes, armor or equipment; No dominant golden/ochre fantasy palette; No settlement architecture as the subject; No readable text or HUD

IDs (reference only): pliegaviento

Notes: Ficha de Dirección de Arte. La referencia de Hoshai fija únicamente contexto regional/paleta/terreno; la anatomía manda desde el canon escrito. Una sola generación por ejecución. No publicar ni integrar a assets/.

Use the attached reference images according to the art direction and constraints above.

issues: Six-support plan not clearly legible — the reduced anterior pair of limbs is not unambiguously visible as two distinct supporting appendages (image reads primarily as four large limbs).

Lateral membranes read as wing/gliding surfaces — the stretched skin between body and limbs appears wing-like and could be interpreted as gliding wings rather than purely as low, tensioned stabilizers.
critique.reasoning: The image meets many requirements (adult shown full on a rocky cornice, low three-quarter lateral camera, cold/neutral daylight, compact low silhouette conveying grip and resistance). However the canonical 4+2 support plan is not made unambiguous: the reduced anterior pair is not clearly visible on both sides as legible supports, so the anatomy risks being interpreted as only four limbs. In addition the large lateral membranes appear wing-like and suggest gliding, which violates the brief's prohibition on wings/gliding (membranas should read clearly as stabilizers, not as flight surfaces). Fixing these two issues (make the small anterior limbs clearly visible as supports and visually reduce the wing-like appearance of the membranes so they read as stabilizers) should bring the image into compliance.
